description: This file provides YAML and JSON serialization/deserialization utilities, including functions for marshaling, unmarshaling, and converting between YAML and JSON formats, with support for strict mode and custom options.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes an object into JSON and then converts it to YAML.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Converts YAML bytes to an object, decoding case-insensitively, with optional JSON decoding options.

methods.name: UnmarshalStrict
methods.description: Strict version of Unmarshal that errors on duplicate fields and unknown fields in structs.

methods.name: JSONToYAML
methods.description: Converts JSON bytes to YAML bytes, preserving number types.

methods.name: YAMLToJSON
methods.description: Converts YAML bytes to JSON bytes, with optional strict decoding.

methods.name: YAMLToJSONStrict
methods.description: Strict version of YAMLToJSON that errors on duplicate fields.

methods.name: DisallowUnknownFields
methods.description: Configures a JSON decoder to error on unknown fields.
